title: China Raises Half the World's Pork — and Stockpiles It | China Travel Expert
description:
Pork is the meat of China — and the scale is staggering. In 2025 the USDA put China's pork output at about 57 million tonnes out of roughly 116.7 million worldwide: close to half the planet's pork from one country.

It matters so much that China keeps a national pork reserve — a government stockpile of frozen pork set up in 2007. When hog prices crash, the state buys and freezes to put a floor under farmers; when prices spike, it releases pork to cool the market. A strategic reserve, for meat.

🧭 Expert Tip: Your first bowl should be hongshaorou (红烧肉) — red-braised pork belly, sweet-savoury and glossy. It's the dish that explains the obsession.

中国一年产猪肉约 5700 万吨，接近全球一半，还有从 2007 年起的国家猪肉储备——价贱收储、价高投放。
